Projects

A collection of datasets, tools, and research initiatives spanning medical AI, synthetic data, and clinical decision support.

DeepFake ECG: Synthetic Electrocardiogram Generation

Completed

DeepFake ECG introduces a GAN-based framework for generating realistic synthetic electrocardiogram signals. The project demonstrates that synthetic ECGs can augment training data for arrhythmia classifiers while preserving patient privacy, achieving performance on par with models trained on real clinical ECGs.

SEARCH: Synthetic hEalthcare dAta goveRnanCe Hub

Active

SEARCH pioneers healthcare innovation by combining synthetic data generation with federated learning to create a secure, privacy-preserving ecosystem for healthcare data sharing. The project addresses GDPR compliance and enables AI-driven clinical decision support across cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, and gynecological diseases, contributing to the European Health Data Space.

DADAP: Digitizing and Automating the Diagnostic Psychiatric Assessment Process

Active

DADAP transforms psychiatric diagnostics for children and adolescents by leveraging AI, machine learning, and digitalization to enhance screening efficiency and throughput. The European consortium project aims to modernize diagnostic assessment workflows in child and adolescent psychiatry, improving access and reducing waiting times for mental health evaluations.

ECGDatasets: A Curated Catalogue of Public ECG Datasets

Active

ECGDatasets is a community-maintained catalogue of 64+ publicly available ECG datasets from clinical hospitals, challenge competitions, and research institutions. It consolidates metadata scattered across PhysioNet, Zenodo, and Figshare into a single searchable reference, covering 12-lead, 2-lead, and 1-lead configurations. Includes Python analysis scripts and interactive D3.js visualisations for supported datasets.
